findings.text: git failure raises CalledProcessError, not OSError/ValueError; now escapes, scripts/runner.py:691
findings.consequence: If a git call inside the lane record fails on a real machine, the person shipping a light ticket may see the run die at the end instead of a one-line note. The work is already merged at that point, so they must re-run or clean up by hand. The new test only exercises OSError, so this path is untested.
